# asyntai_websites (Data Source)

All websites (AI agents) in the Asyntai account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "asyntai_websites" "all" {}

output "domains" {
  value = [for w in data.asyntai_websites.all.websites : w.domain]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `websites` (Attributes List) The websites. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--websites))

### Nested Schema for `websites`

- `id` (String) Website id.
- `is_primary` (Boolean) Whether this is the primary website.
